evidence.title: 内务府 repair list 乾隆四十三年 (as quoted in S220)
evidence.locator: S220 section 三; archive not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 明善堂后碧涛书屋、双寿寺、眺吟楼、浩然亭、松风萝月等处捞堆坍塌山石泊岸、码头，勾抿油灰
evidence.summary: Earliest dated mention of these places. Settles the plan readings of QC53 松风萝月 and QC54 眺吟楼, both partly unread on S01.

evidence.title: 毕沅 《春和园纪游》 荻蒲 诗序 (as quoted in S220)
evidence.date: 乾隆; S220 gives no year. Describes Fuheng's garden, so before he gave it up
evidence.locator: S220 section 三; primary not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 海于天地为物最巨，谓其受纳广博也。园中西海子南受双寿寺前水，东受北海子水，旷如也，奥如也。南有凝翠轩，沿缘而上，多小石山，山无大林，木皆短松瘦竹……右转而北，崇冈俯仰，最高者为岚翠亭、横翠山房，次之浩然亭、眺吟楼……下瞰湖波，渺弥沦涟，千顷一碧。
evidence.summary: The northern ridge above the back lake with short pines and thin bamboo; 浩然亭 and 眺吟楼 look down on the water. Useful for planting and for terrain at QC54, QC57.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 凤麟洲
evidence.summary: Two islands joined by a winding bridge, begun 1807. Main hall seven bays in two rolls with a five-bay annex, an open hall 绣漪轩 before it, a side court east, a service court on the small east island. On another island to the north is the double-eaved square 浩然亭, and beyond it the gate to 长春园.
